definitions.explanation: A suffix attached to a Sino-Japanese noun to mean "after that event": {退職後|たいしょくご} (after retirement), {卒業後|そつぎょうご} (after graduation). Written-style and very productive.

examples.japanese: {卒業後|そつぎょうご}に{就職|しゅうしょく}した。
examples.english: I got a job after graduating.

examples.japanese: {手術後|しゅじゅつご}は{安静|あんせい}にしてください。
examples.english: Please rest quietly after the operation.

examples.japanese: {退職後|たいしょくご}の{生活|せいかつ}をどう{過|す}ごすか、{今|いま}のうちから{考|かんが}えておいたほうがいい。
examples.english: It is better to start thinking now about how to spend life after retirement.

notes:
The on'yomi of {後|うし}ろ・{後|あと}, used only as a bound suffix. It attaches directly to a Sino-Japanese noun with no particle, and the result behaves as a time noun.

COMMON EXAMPLES:
- {卒業後|そつぎょうご}: after graduation
- {退職後|たいしょくご}: after retirement
- {食後|しょくご}: after a meal
- {戦後|せんご}: postwar
- {使用後|しようご}: after use

USAGE:
It cannot be attached to native Japanese nouns — say {試合|しあい}の{後|あと} rather than combining {後|ご} with a wago word.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後|あと}: after — the free-standing word, used with の after any noun
- {前|ぜん}: pre-, before — the matching suffix, as in {食前|しょくぜん} (before a meal)
